Runes are consumables that can be used to drastically change an item during the crafting process.

## Mechanics[]

Runes are a crafting item that can be used in the support item slot on the crafting panel. They can greatly change the affixes on an item, or they can even completely destroy it.

Like Glyphs, they can either drop from random enemies and containers, or they are awarded from certain echoes in the Monolith of Fate. Repeatable content - like the Arena and dungeons - also offer them at certain milestones.

Most Runes also require Forging Potential to use.

## List of Runes[]

| Name | Requires FP? | Effect on Use |

| Rune of Shattering | No | The item is destroyed, returning a random number of affix shards present. |

| Rune of Removal | Yes | A random affix is removed, returning a number of said shards based on its tier. |

| Rune of Shaping | Yes | All implicits are re-rolled. |

| Rune of Refinement | Yes | All affixes are re-rolled within their tiers. |

| Rune of Discovery | Yes | All open slots are added random tier 1 affixes. Uses no Forging Potential. |

| Rune of Ascendance | Yes | Replaces the item with a unique or set item of the same type (world drops only). |

| Rune of Creation | Yes | Duplicates the item, setting Forging Potential on both items to 0. |

| Rune of Research | Yes | An Experimental Affix is sealed, randomly granting a Glyph of Insight. |
